tasks.description: In docs/concepts/visualization.rst, in the 'Apply custom style' section (or a new subsection near it), document that a node's `display_name` tag is used as its label in graphviz visualizations. Explain resolution order (explicit name param > display_name tag > node name), that list values use the first element (empty list falls back to node name), and that values are HTML-escaped. Include a short @tag(display_name=...) example.

In docs/concepts/function-modifiers.rst under the @tag section (and/or docs/reference/decorators/tag.rst), mention the special `display_name` tag that controls the label shown in graphviz visualizations, cross-referencing the visualization docs.
